newsitem.title: DUBAI: Dubai air cargo volumes rise 18 percent in June.
newsitem.headline: Dubai air cargo volumes rise 18 percent in June.

text.p: Dubai airport cargo volumes rose 18 percent in June to 33,807 tonnes from 28,642 tonnes in the same month last year, Dubai Cargo Village figures show.
Exports rose a year-on-year 11.5 percent to 15,232 tonnes, and imports moved up 24 percent to 18,574 tonnes. The figures include transit goods but do not include courier and mail items.
Trans-shipments in the month totalled 6,912 tonnes, a 40 percent increase on June 1996's figure.
Dubai is the second largest emirate and commercial centre of the seven members of the United Arab Emirates.
